items.excerpt: Community publishing is now live for Figma's Weave tools. Figma highlights five standout community-built tools, from turning a moodboard into a realistic room mockup to previewing a nail set.
Creative coder and educator Zach Lieberman explains the throughline between drawing and computation, and why breaking tools is part of his practice.
Autodesk's AU 2026 message to creatives is that AI should help you make more rather than make the work for you — but Creative Bloq probes where that line actually sits for artists.
Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost says AI needs guardrails, but the more immediate disruption for creatives is already happening in animation and VFX pipelines.
Ten uncomfortable UX lessons drawn from real product mistakes — where best-practice advice that sounds right in theory falls apart once shipped.
UX Collective maps five eras of UX design and asks which craft lessons designers should carry into the AI era, and which ones to let go.
Canva ships Affinity 3.3 as part of the Canva ProSuite: a major update to the free image editing and vector design app adding scores of features, new AI models, and a new scripting system.
Pavel Kuzmenko details texLab, a native C++ Unreal Engine plugin for packing PBR maps, built on a JSON semantic database pipeline TDs can extend.
Cornelius Dämmrich walks through Egdy, a Cinema 4D and Blender plugin with six damage modules that generate lifelike cracks, chips and worn edges procedurally.
Anthropic adds docs and slideshow creation plus Cowork capabilities directly inside Claude chat, rolling out to Pro and Max subscribers first.
Apple Reference Image gives iPhone 18 Pro photos a tamper-proof provenance seal — a hardware-level answer to the question of what counts as an unedited image in the AI era.
Autodesk updates the AI inside Fusion and Inventor — including AutoAssemble — pitching it as 'unlocking design capacity' by automating more of the modelling grind.
SimScale's Engineering AI Agent lands inside Onshape, handling CAD prep, simulation setup, physics analysis and results review through natural-language prompts.
A roundup of the AI highlights from Autodesk University 2026, centred on how the Autodesk Assistant is evolving across design and make workflows.
Autodesk previews a next-generation Assistant that connects project data, specialized tools and third-party agents, with a standalone experience planned for 2027.
Autodesk refreshes its AI Transparency Cards so designers can ask trust and data-use questions directly inside Autodesk Assistant instead of hunting through policy docs.
Autodesk lays out where AI can shorten the media and entertainment production loop — speeding iteration and feedback while keeping creative work editable and artist-controlled.
Meta is reportedly unveiling its next-gen Project Phoenix mixed reality headset at Connect alongside a photorealistic 'hologram-like' calling experience built on its latest codec avatars.
Meta is reportedly preparing smart glasses that drop the camera entirely after public backlash — a product-design retreat driven by how the wearable reads socially.
Craig Storm had never built a VR app. Eight days later his AI-assisted Quest game Punchable Face was live on Meta's store — a case study in how far vibe coding now carries a non-developer.
The $149 Arcturus Vision Camera adds 6MP-per-eye color passthrough to Steam Frame and captures tracked 3D HDR video, opening a cheap capture path for spatial creators.
OpenArt's new Arena benchmarks image and video models by creative job — filmmaking, e-commerce, motion design, lip sync — using blind pairwise comparisons from working creatives.
Anthropic folds Cowork into the main Claude chat and introduces Claude Docs and Claude Slides — editable, collaborative artifacts that live inside the conversation instead of being one-shot outputs.
AWS's open-source Pizza Bot reframes the agent interface as an asynchronous inbox rather than a chat window, betting that long-running agent work needs a different interaction model.
Figma walks through how to build and publish your own custom Weave tools, now that community publishing is open.
Visual artist and creative technologist Aitana Picó shares the source material behind her style in Figma's ongoing series on creative influence.
Matt Wolfe tests a new AI agent and is surprised by how little setup it takes to get useful work out of it.
